question: Which programmes are available?
answer:
The University of Ibadan offers undergraduate programmes across its faculties and colleges. The Undergraduate Admissions Office processes admission into the various academic programmes using prescribed rules and regulations.

The official list of programmes with UTME subjects, O’Level requirements and Direct Entry requirements is published in the University’s Regulations for UTME and Direct Entry: https://admissions.ui.edu.ng/Regulation.pdf

Use that regulations document and the admissions portal to confirm whether a programme is offered in the current cycle.
source: UI Undergraduate Admissions Office; UI Regulations (UTME & Direct Entry)

question: How do I check requirements for my course?
answer:
Programme-specific UTME subject combinations and O’Level requirements are published in the official University of Ibadan Regulations for UTME and Direct Entry (Regulation.pdf). The 2026/2027 screening notice also directs candidates to view UTME combination and O’Level requirements for their courses of choice in those regulations.

Do not copy another programme’s requirements. Always match the exact programme name in the official document.
source: UI Regulations (UTME & Direct Entry); Screening Notice 2026/2027

question: How do I enter UI as a Computer Science student?
answer:
According to the official UI Regulations for UTME and Direct Entry (Computer Science under Computing) and the Undergraduate Admissions Office:

**UTME subjects:** English Language, Mathematics, Chemistry and Physics.

**O’Level:** 5 O’Level subjects at one sitting or 6 at two sittings to include English Language, Mathematics, Chemistry, Physics and one other Science subject (excluding Agricultural Science).

**University UTME minimum:** at least 200 out of 400 (departmental cut-offs may be higher).

**Direct Entry (from regulations):** (i) Two A-level subject passes in Mathematics (pure or applied) and Physics; or (ii) OND/HND in Computer Science or any other Mathematics-based courses with Upper Credit. IBADAN accepts OND/HND in Computer Science with Upper Credit.

**Programme length (Faculty of Science, Department of Computer Science):** B.Sc Computer Science — 4 years for UTME students and 3 years for Direct Entry students.

**Next steps:** Choose UI and Computer Science in JAMB, meet the requirements above, then complete Post-UTME / screening registration on https://admissions.ui.edu.ng when the cycle is open.
source: UI Regulations (UTME & Direct Entry); Faculty of Science — Computer Science

question: Where can I learn more about a specific programme?
answer:
For admission subject requirements, use the official UI Regulations PDF: https://admissions.ui.edu.ng/Regulation.pdf

For departmental programme descriptions (duration, options), check the relevant faculty/department pages on ui.edu.ng (for example, Faculty of Science Computer Science programme page). Screening and registration instructions are published on the admissions portal and University news notices.
source: UI Regulations; University of Ibadan web faculties
